A memecoin is a token whose value comes almost entirely from attention and community rather than an underlying product, cash flow or protocol. Prices can spike on hype at launch and give most of it back just as fast when attention fades.

The informational point (this is not advice): memecoins are among the most volatile things in crypto, launch-day prices are frequently the least representative, and “featured” or trending status reflects attention, not quality. Understanding the mechanism is the best defence against being surprised by it.
